positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managed and led design system (Helios) engineering development and objectives
Collaborated and supported engineering teams using Helios design system with office hours, Slack, documentation, and Storybook
Led initiatives for design system migration, releases and worked closely with design team
Started front end guild to support engineering mentorship and knowledge share
Maintained and built new components in React, Typescript, Tailwind CSS, Jest, React Testing Library, Storybook
Audited design system for accessibility to build out next steps and long term plan to be fully accessible
Mentored other engineers for design system contributions and facilitated action items for improvements
Operated across multiple organizations and coordinated with leadership on design system decisions and availability for engineers

positions.title: Frontend Engineer II
positions.description:
Architected and documented frontend architecture and integration with server side GraphQL layer 
Identified constraints and strategized timely execution based on requirements
Learned how to set up AWS infrastructure in Java code base
Rolled out product incrementally to European countries and iterated with feedback from customers and product
Influenced internal stakeholders to use tools that optimized performance and user experience that were not previously being used
Owned creation and iteration of UX designs 
Received direct feedback from product and customers to iterate and implement improvements
Mentor junior developers in frontend development and design
People manage one engineer with weekly 1:1s, feedback, and support

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Explored and instrumented architecture with modular components, separation of the data and view layer, and utilizing React hooks
Worked closely with design and product to prioritize and release features, bug fixes, etc
Our team created the front end for Gatsby Cloud using Emotion, Gatsby, React, GraphQL, Jest, React testing library, ESLint, and Cypress
Released Gatsby Preview Beta and Gatsby Cloud GA
Led projects, paired and delegated tasks with front and back end engineers
Aligned with 3rd parties to create extensions for unification
Introduced a new process for design and engineering to work together more quickly and efficiently 
Helped the backend team maintain and update Prisma data models and GraphQL mutations and queries on the server side
Started Gatsby share to bring together different teams and discuss front end topics

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Advised and helped client to migrate legacy app to modern front end app (React, PostCSS, Parcel, Jest testing) working with their development, product, and design team
Encouraged client to instill agile practices to improve quality and efficiency
Managed all code and CircleCI in GitLab
Mentored junior developers with code reviews and architectural discussions

positions.title: Developer Advocate
positions.description: I spoke at conferences, wrote blog posts, held workshops, and released videos about different technologies, specifically focusing on Kubernetes, Docker, containers, and how it fits into the development ecosystem. I helped contribute and maintain open source projects and interacted with developers on a day to day basis.

positions.title: Staff Front End Developer
positions.description: I led a team of front end developers, along with designers and offering managers, to improve the provisioning experience for VSIs in the IBM Cloud. We increased conversion by over 250% and directly influenced an increase in revenue.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description: I helped develop several different areas of the IBM Cloud front end. I worked with designers, developers and offering managers to complete projects to create a great user experience and help our customers easily navigate and use the cloud.

positions.title: Capstone Project Engineer
positions.description:
Developed web application for diagnostic-based troubleshooting in a large scale SOA based SaaS environment
Based application framework on Spring MVC
Connected to Ticketmaster Active Directory and utilized Spring Security for user authentication and authorization 
Integration with RESTful services and Elasticsearch API 
Functionality and interface implementation included the use of Java, Javascript, and jQuery
Results displayed in a tree view, raw JSON view, and dynamic table

positions.title: Technical Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Evaluated and recommended file sharing solution to encourage collaboration and productivity among employees on all workstations including “Bring Your Own Device”
Collaborated with UX, software, and security teams to determine design and functionality requirements
Partnered with team members and various vendors to gather and compare product capabilities with given requirements
Helped organize demo environments for team members to test and assess
Tested products in iOS, Android, and Windows environments
Created high level architecture diagrams on how solution would integrate into current infrastructure and MDM solution
Presented recommendation to leadership and executives
